title: Getting started with spliv
text: spliv() estimator accepts usual IV formula y ~ X | Z. Ordinary exogenous controls belong sides, y ~ x + w | z + w. method bound supplied, baseline UCI delta = 0; positive delta allows bounded uniform direct effect. default scale, delta outcome-unit direct effect one-residual-SD instrument shift.
code: baseline <- spliv(f, d, vcov = "hc1") baseline$estimates #>          term   conf.low conf.high #> 1 (Intercept) -0.1605207 0.1107809 #> 2           x  0.9391974 1.6391314 #> 3           w -0.0851201 0.3415725 uniform <- spliv(f, d, method = "uci", delta = 0.20, vcov = "hc1",                  grid = list(steps = 9)) uniform$estimates #>          term   conf.low conf.high #> 1 (Intercept) -0.2340356 0.1964620 #> 2           x  0.3485695 2.2672576 #> 3           w -0.3722147 0.6281993

title: Getting started with spliv
text: BPE uses outcome-independent subset specified examining outcome analysis requires non-empty transportability rationale. Validation reports eligibility diagnostics; search across candidate subgroups. default sampling transport uses estimated reduced-form sampling covariance; conservative adds pre-specified covariance inflation. bpe_explore_subsets() available transparent exploratory diagnostics, exploratory subgroup search selecting first passing rule confirmatory BPE. Confirmatory claims require pre-specified design reported validation record.
code: design <- bpe_design(   name = "Theory-defined inactive subset", subset = ~ inactive,   rationale = "The treatment channel is absent in the inactive subset.",   variables_used = "inactive", subset_type = "theory_defined",   pre_specified = TRUE,   transportability_rationale = "The subset direct effect is informative for the target sample." ) # Illustrative synthetic margin: 0.25 residual treatment SD per # one-residual-SD instrument shift. In substantive work, pre-specify the # margin rather than tuning it to obtain BPE eligibility. bpe_margin <- 0.25 validation <- bpe_validate_design(   f, d, design = design, vcov = "hc1",   bpe_min_n_S = 40,   bpe_equiv_margin = bpe_margin ) validation[c("n_S", "equivalence_passed", "eligibility_passed")] #> $n_S #> [1] 120 #>  #> $equivalence_passed #> [1] FALSE #>  #> $eligibility_passed #> [1] FALSE  bpe_fit <- spliv(f, d, method = "bpe", bpe_design = design,                  vcov = "hc1", bpe_min_n_S = 40,                  bpe_equiv_margin = bpe_margin) bpe_fit$estimates #>          term estimate std.error conf.low conf.high #> 1 (Intercept)       NA        NA       NA        NA #> 2           x       NA        NA       NA        NA #> 3           w       NA        NA       NA        NA

code: install.packages("spliv") remotes::install_github("koren6684/spliv")

title: Patterned Sensitivity Analysis for IV with Fixed Effects
text: examples self-contained use empirical restricted data.
code: library(spliv)  set.seed(42) n <- 240 z <- rnorm(n) w <- rnorm(n) exposure <- pnorm(w) inactive <- seq_len(n) <= n / 2 x <- ifelse(inactive, 0, 1) * z + 0.4 * w + rnorm(n) y <- 1.2 * x + 0.25 * w + 0.15 * exposure * z + rnorm(n)  d <- data.frame(y, x, z, w, exposure, inactive) f <- y ~ x + w | z + w

title: Patterned Sensitivity Analysis for IV with Fixed Effects
text: method bound supplied, spliv() uses UCI delta = 0 reproduces conventional IV confidence interval strict exclusion.
code: baseline <- spliv(   f,   d,   vcov = "hc1" )  baseline$estimates

title: Patterned Sensitivity Analysis for IV with Fixed Effects
text: Union--confidence-intervals (UCI) sensitivity allows excluded instrument’s direct effect vary bounded interval. default scale, delta outcome-unit direct effect one-residual-SD shift instrument.
code: uniform <- spliv(   f,   d,   method = "uci",   delta = 0.20,   vcov = "hc1",   grid = list(steps = 11) )  uniform$estimates

title: Patterned Sensitivity Analysis for IV with Fixed Effects
text: Use theory-motivated spliv_pattern() allow possible direct effect vary observed exposure. package supports bounded UCI local--zero (LTZ) sensitivity.
code: pattern <- spliv_pattern(   name = "Exposure pattern",   pattern = ~ exposure,   rationale = "The alternative channel is expected to be stronger at higher exposure.",   variables_used = "exposure",   pattern_type = "theory_defined",   normalize = "max_abs" )  patterned_uci <- spliv(   f,   d,   method = "uci",   delta = 0.20,   vcov = "hc1",   violation_pattern = pattern,   grid = list(steps = 11) )  patterned_ltz <- spliv(   f,   d,   method = "ltz",   delta = 0.20,   vcov = "hc1",   violation_pattern = pattern )  patterned_uci$estimates patterned_ltz$estimates

title: Patterned Sensitivity Analysis for IV with Fixed Effects
text: Sensitivity paths report estimated interval changes pre-specified range direct-effect magnitudes. tipping point first value supplied grid interval includes zero.
code: path <- spliv_sensitivity_path(   f,   d,   method = "uci",   delta_grid = seq(0, 0.30, by = 0.05),   vcov = "hc1",   violation_pattern = pattern )  head(path) spliv_tipping_point(path) plot(path, term = "x")

title: Patterned Sensitivity Analysis for IV with Fixed Effects
text: Confirmatory Beyond Plausibly Exogenous (BPE) analysis begins pre-specified, outcome-independent instrument-inactive subset explicit transportability rationale. package validates proposed design estimates BPE model eligibility diagnostics pass. default sampling transport carries estimated reduced-form sampling covariance; conservative adds pre-specified covariance inflation. bpe_explore_subsets() exploratory diagnostic. Searching across subgroups reporting first passing rule confirmatory BPE; confirmatory BPE requires pre-specified bpe_design() substantive rationale transportability statement.
code: design <- bpe_design(   name = "Theory-defined inactive subset",   subset = ~ inactive,   rationale = "The treatment channel is absent in the inactive subset.",   variables_used = "inactive",   subset_type = "theory_defined",   pre_specified = TRUE,   transportability_rationale = "The subset direct effect is informative for the target sample." )  # This illustrative margin allows a first-stage effect of 0.25 residual # treatment SD per one-residual-SD instrument shift. In substantive work, # pre-specify the margin; do not tune it to make BPE pass. bpe_margin <- 0.25  validation <- bpe_validate_design(   f,   d,   design = design,   vcov = "hc1",   bpe_min_n_S = 40,   bpe_equiv_margin = bpe_margin )  validation[c(   "n_S",   "equivalence_passed",   "eligibility_passed" )]  bpe_fit <- spliv(   f,   d,   method = "bpe",   bpe_design = design,   vcov = "hc1",   bpe_min_n_S = 40,   bpe_equiv_margin = bpe_margin )  bpe_fit$estimates

Confirmatory BPE equivalence intervals now compared documented, unit-invariant scale: residual treatment standard deviations per one- residual-SD instrument shift. Raw standardized diagnostics retained separately. corrects 0.1.x eligibility calculations compared raw coefficient interval scale-aware margin. Confirmatory BPE now requires non-empty transportability rationale uses aligned sampling conservative covariance modes standalone validation final estimation. Exploratory subset diagnostics retain first-stage F-statistics descriptive information longer expose F-threshold selection control. Numerical-equivalence, BPE invariance, fixed-effect, clustered-inference, edge-case, plotting tests expanded. treatment-effect formula sensitivity estimand intentionally changed apart BPE equivalence-scale correction . finalized 72-case equivalent-computation benchmark added dev/.
